summary: Master GIS for Disaster Management. Learn hazard modeling, emergency response mapping, and damage assessment using ArcGIS and QGIS. Enroll today.
lede: GIS for disaster management uses spatial data and mapping to support hazard assessment and emergency planning. For GIS analysts, emergency coordinators, risk reduction specialists and urban planners, the course addresses practical work across mitigation, preparedness, response and recovery. Participants learn to build vulnerability indexes, map hazards from satellite imagery, plan evacuation routes and conduct mobile damage assessments, then communicate findings through GIS dashboards.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is built for professionals who already possess a foundational understanding of geospatial concepts and seek to specialize in the high-stakes domain of emergency management.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of basic GIS concepts, including coordinate systems, vector/raster data types, and basic map production. Experience with ArcGIS Pro or QGIS is required. No programming knowledge is necessary, though familiarity with data tables is beneficial.
